sara_cs: OrchidAI QBR preflight — noticed a steep embed/token spike last week after their v2 launch. QBR in 48h, we need token econ + any enablement asks. Who can pull the 7d/30d burn and flag anomalies? :eyes:

mike_finops: I can pull the numbers. Quick ask — do we want top-level by route (chat vs embed) and model family?

sara_cs: yes please. route + model family + peak day. Also call out any new API keys or partner integrations.

alex_se: flagging that they rolled the webhook integration on Tue — likely increased context lengths. I'll confirm with logs.

ellie_onboarding: I ran a quick user checklist — their onboarding queue shows 3 feature requests: streaming, fallback model, and cheaper embed options. I can prep enablement slides if we have the econ numbers.

mike_finops: grabbing data now. SQL snippet I'm running: ```sql
SELECT route, model_family, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(cost_usd) as cost, max(day) as peak_day
FROM usage_events
WHERE account = 'orchidai' AND day >= current_date - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route, model_family
ORDER BY tokens DESC;
```

mike_finops: quick paste of 7d vs 30d (prelim): 7d tokens = 12.4M, cost = $2,980; 30d tokens = 18.6M, cost = $4,210. 75% of 7d tokens are embeddings (route=embed, model_family=open-embed). Peak day = 1718563200 (Tue) at ~5.2M tokens.

jen_support: saw two tickets about contextual length causing duplicate prompts — might be doubling cost for some calls. Ticket IDs: #4521, #4523.

ellie_onboarding: perfect — I'll add that to the enablement slide: guidance on prefix trimming + fallbacks to smaller embed model.

sara_cs: ok action items: mike finalizes a short token econ table (route/model/cost/peak). ellie prepares 2-slide enablement ask (what to teach customer + migration path to cheaper embed). alex to confirm whether webhook rollout added 2x context. jen to consolidate relevant tickets for QBR. I'll own the QBR ask deck and runbook.

alex_se: confirmed webhook added ~40% more avg context length on Tue (from 350 to 490 tokens). Not full 3.8x but combined with extra embed calls explains the spike.

cost-alert-bot: [alert] account=orchidai threshold=90% of monthly commit reached. current_month_spend=$8,410 commit=$9,300.

mike_finops: noted the commit alert — projecting month-end spend ~ $9.9k if current rate holds. I'll add a mitigations row: batching, quantized embed option, rate-limiting for non-critical prefixes.

ellie_onboarding: I'll prepare a short rollout plan for reducing embed unit cost: 1) migrate infrequent queries to cached vectors, 2) introduce smaller embed model for non-critical metadata, 3) set soft rate limits and alerting. Slide + one-pager in 90m.

sara_cs: timeline: deck ready in 3 hours, econ table finalized in 60m, tickets bundled in 45m. Calling out priority: get commit projection + mitigations so we can propose an extension or commit change during QBR.

jen_support: bundling tickets now, will DM the QBR doc link when done.

mike_finops: uploading econ table to the QBR doc: https://console.redwood.ai/qbr/orchidai/econ (shared).

sara_cs: thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll run a dry-run 30m before the QBR. If anyone uncovers extra anomalies ping me in this thread.

ellie_onboarding: adding a short customer-facing email template for urgent cost controls (will drop here).

alex_se: small note — recommend enabling prefix caching for their largest route; I'll include the config snippet in doc.```
